brief:
Israeli occupation authorities have demolished 1,059 Palestinian structures since the beginning of 2026, Shehab Wire reported. The demolished facilities include residential homes, economic installations, and agricultural buildings scattered across the West Bank.

The campaign represents a significant escalation in Israel's destruction of Palestinian infrastructure. The targeted demolitions directly affect housing availability, employment opportunities, and agricultural production across Palestinian communities in the occupied territory. Homes, workshops, commercial premises, and farming facilities have been systematically razed, according to the report, dismantling essential components of Palestinian livelihood and economic self-sufficiency in the West Bank.
